name: Hame☆Dori ~Happy Mellowly Dreams!~
source:
Main student is an ordinary college student who used to be a legendary AV photographer in older days. Suddenly the director of female study group jumps before him and revitalizes his former talent. The college life provides material for a much larger scale film production.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位普通的大学生，曾经是昔日传奇的AV摄影师。突然，女学习小组组长跳到了他的面前，让他恢复了往日的才华。大学生活为更大规模的电影制作提供了素材。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
